description: Zero-dependency, ultra-fast multilingual (English/Chinese/Korean/Russian/Spanish/French/Vietnamese/Thai/slang) to Japanese Katakana converter for Japanese TTS engines, powered by a native Rust core.
Frameless Avalonia window with a custom title bar and Linux distro inspired themes.
Official .NET SDK for InfiniAnalytics: registers the start, events, warnings, errors and end of your automation executions without a network failure ever breaking the robot.

Satellite-to-host log forwarding for RoushTech.Asio over any transport: streams job sessions and the app-log tail through a consumer-supplied IAsioForwardingTransport. Bounded drop-oldest buffering; consecutive same-session appends are coalesced into a single frame.
Figma-style comments for a running .NET MAUI app. Tap an element, write a note, and it reaches your coding agent (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and others) over MCP through a Notato server.
Strongly typed, validated settings on top of the Options pattern: the type names its own configuration section, DI hands out the plain settings object, and an enum picks the reload behaviour.
